_about: Settings for AlivenessLint (docs/design/ALIVENESS.md sections 4 and 5). Outside the Mirror catalog and its fingerprint. 'important' names the objects rule 7 applies to. 'known_gaps' is a ratchet: a rule an object does not meet yet is reported as a warning only while it is listed here; every other failure is an error, and a listed gap that now holds is an error too (delete the line, so it can never regress). known_gaps are content questions the design freeze owns: path_out has no edge until the ending (DQ4); tomas and bell have no knowledge-gated option yet (NQ-b, DQ1). metrics are the section 5 ratchet, measured on data/sim on 2026-10-16 (attention return 1.00, no dead taps).
